subject: maths
question: A invested 30% more than B. B invested 40% less than C, who invested Rs. 8,000. The average of the total amount invested by all of them together (to the nearest Rs.) is:
solution:
**Given:**

A invested 30% more than B

B invested 40% less than C

Investment of C = Rs. 8000

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Investment of B = 8000 - 8000 × 40%

⇒ Rs. 4800

Investment of A = 4800 + 4800 × 30%

⇒ Rs. 6240

Total investment of them = 6240 + 4800 + 8000

⇒ 19040

Average of the investment of them = 19040/3

⇒ Rs. 6346.67 ≈ Rs. 6347

**∴ The average of the total amount invested by all of them together (to the nearest Rs.) is 6347.**
